what: AI blocker / filter that stops AI-generated content or bots from flooding feeds and interactions. User explicitly says they'd pay without second thought.
why_us: Massive anti-AI fatigue signal. High engagement (149 likes). Clear willingness to pay. Repeatable across platforms as AI content explodes.

what: App that lets startup employees spend locked equity (cap table) instantly on rent, flights, groceries etc.
why_us: Clear pain of illiquid equity. Founder-level discussion. High bookmarks (28). Solves real liquidity problem for tech workers.

what: Postiz (Agentic Social Media Scheduler) hit $171k MRR / $2M ARR. Going all-in on marketing.
why_us: Concrete high revenue numbers from solo/small team SaaS. Shows agentic tools and social scheduling still print money. Distribution edge mentioned.

what: Intelligence AI / DesignArena parent company grew from $5M to $60M ARR in 6 months, profitably, team of 10. 5.5M users.
why_us: Extreme growth signal in AI evaluation/proving grounds space. Index Ventures backed. Real-world AI proving demand.

what: SuperX at $22k MRR, progressing to $100k MRR. Another product hit $9k/mo in 4 days.
why_us: Transparent indie growth tracking. Multiple products. Shows consistent shipping + monetization works.

what: Alarm app Wayk making $200k/mo. Clones reaching $10k MRR in months. Cloning validated apps still works.
why_us: Proven category with high revenue. Easy replication signal for micro-SaaS. High engagement on cloning discussion.

what: TikTok script-display app (shows script while filming) making $300k MRR. Video hit 5M views.
why_us: Viral content + high MRR. Daily-use utility app with low churn potential. Clear clone opportunity.

what: Lovable AI app builder hit $100M revenue in 8 months, later $500M ARR. Small team (20-25 eng) using ClickHouse for observability.
why_us: Massive AI wrapper/builder success. Shows natural language + code gen still hyper-growth. Infra lessons included.

what: Solo founder Ben Broca: AI tools for entrepreneurs, 10k paying customers, on track $10M revenue this year, zero employees.
why_us: Classic one-person AI company. Validates lean AI product model. WSJ coverage adds credibility.

what: Overpriced automation (Zapier-style) and customer messaging tools. Opportunity for focused vertical automation at flat $9-19/mo and simple indie-SaaS chat+tickets at $19/mo.
why_us: Clear pricing pain + feature gaps identified in analysis. Solo-dev replaceable tools. High willingness for cheaper focused alternatives.
